title: BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) — Program Guide: Tiers, Insureds Written and Limits
content:
BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) are Tidemark's commercial flood program, written on a surplus lines basis for businesses, landlords and property owners. The program is written in six tiers, each for a defined kind of insured and each with its own highest limits. All amounts below are in USD.

## 1. Insureds written by each tier

| Tier | Written for | Locations |
|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | A business entity, landlord or non-profit owning the building; contents are not written | At most 1 |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | A business entity owning the building and its business personal property | At most 1 |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | An operating business at the location, with business income records available | At most 1 |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | The owner of a building insured under an NFIP General Property Form policy, with that NFIP policy in force | At most 1 |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | A business entity with several owned or leased locations | At least 2 and at most 25 |
| BizFlood Large Property | A business entity with total insured value above 25,000,000 USD; an engineering inspection is required | At most 50 |

## 2. Highest limits by tier

The building limit and the business personal property (contents) limit are ceilings for each scheduled location; the total insured value is the ceiling across all scheduled locations of the policy; the location count is the highest number of locations the statement of values may schedule. A contents ceiling of 0 means contents are not written on that tier.

| Tier | Building limit per location | Contents limit per location | Total insured value | Locations |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | 5000000 | 0 | 5000000 | 1 |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | 5000000 | 2500000 | 7500000 | 1 |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | 5000000 | 2500000 | 10000000 | 1 |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | 5000000 | 2500000 | 10000000 | 1 |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | 5000000 | 2500000 | 25000000 | 25 |
| BizFlood Large Property | 25000000 | 10000000 | 100000000 | 50 |

## 3. Reading the table

- Five tiers share a building ceiling of 5000000 per location; only BizFlood Large Property goes higher, to 25000000 per location.
- BizFlood Building is the only tier that writes no contents; every other tier writes contents up to 2500000 per location, and BizFlood Large Property up to 10000000.
- The four single-location tiers differ in total insured value: 5000000 on BizFlood Building, 7500000 on BizFlood Building and Contents, and 10000000 on BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income and on BizFlood Excess over NFIP.

## 4. Illustration (hypothetical schedule)

A hypothetical statement of values on BizFlood Multi-Location lists 6 locations, each with a building limit of 3,000,000 and a contents limit of 1,000,000. Each location is within the per-location ceilings of 5000000 and 2500000; the 6 locations are within the ceiling of 25; the total insured value of 24,000,000 is within the ceiling of 25000000. The same schedule with a seventh identical location would total 28,000,000 and would exceed the BizFlood Multi-Location ceiling, while remaining within the BizFlood Large Property ceiling of 100000000.
